15: ```text

17: 初始 NuttX heap: 约 317.44 KiB
18: OpenVela PSRAM allocator: 尚未上线
19: ```

21: 本文沿用原厂“16 MB”产品/配置命名，但容量数值`0x01000000`严格等于16 MiB
22: （16,777,216字节），不是十进制16,000,000字节。目标板PSRAM在CPU地址空间中的
23: memory-mapped半开区间固定为：

26: PSRAM_BASE = 0x60000000
27: PSRAM_SIZE = 0x01000000

31: 本方案采用以下正式架构：
32: 
33: 1. 物理 CPU0/CP 继续作为 PSRAM PHY、LDO、电压、时钟、控制器、器件 ID 检测
34:    和全局电源状态的唯一 owner。
35: 2. OpenVela AP 不调用 `bk_psram_init()`、`bk_psram_deinit()` 或重新配置 PSRAM
36:    控制器，避免与 CP 冲突。

38:    四个媒体 slab、128 KiB CP heap、2.875 MiB AP heap和6 MiB AP section。
39: 4. OpenVela接管原厂 AP侧合计15.875 MiB区域；CP保留128 KiB
40:    `CP_PSRAM_HEAP`，不得与Vela allocator重叠。

42:    保持原用途边界的独立pool；不通过 `arm_addregion()`、
43:    `umm_addregion()` 或 `kmm_addregion()`并入 NuttX 通用 heap。
44: 6. `AP_PSRAM_SECTION`保留给后续经过审计的静态 `.psram.data/.psram.bss`，不得
45:    偷偷并入AP动态heap或媒体pool。
46: 7. NuttX 内核对象、TCB、调度器、Mailbox 控制块、PWC 状态、关键线程栈和
47:    故障恢复状态继续驻留片内 SRAM。

51:    完成专项验证前不启用 cacheable PSRAM。

53:    不允许当前参考驱动的“只告警后继续运行”。
54: 11. PSRAM默认在AP生命周期内保持上电。动态掉电只在AP和CP heap、四个媒体

60: ### 1.1 完成定义
61: 
62: 只有同时满足以下条件，才能称为“OpenVela按原厂布局可用16 MB（16 MiB）板载PSRAM”：

67: - CP map只声明 `0x60700000..0x6071ffff`为 `CP_PSRAM_HEAP`，CP运行时allocator不得越界。

71: - AP section边界和静态对象加载时序通过验证。

73:   AP heap是动态分配区，另6 MiB是只允许经过审计的静态section对象使用的保留容量；任何区域
74:   都不会跨越CP heap。
75: - Vela测试不会读写CP heap；CP heap由CP自身测试和统计。
76: - Mailbox heartbeat、PWC 和日志压力下 PSRAM 数据不损坏。
77: - 音视频 DMA 测试通过，buffer 地址、长度、对齐和 cache 维护规则明确。
78: - AP reset、全芯片 reset 和 PSRAM recovery 不产生旧指针复用或静默损坏。

217: `bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:175-190`。
218: 
219: 这证明 AP 不能复制 CP 的 PHY 初始化。可复用的是 AP 拥有独立allocator、通过
220: PWC请求电源、维护使用计数，以及原厂媒体slab的区域和best-fit算法；不可直接
221: 复用的是 FreeRTOS `heap_4.c`、Beken RTOS mutex/critical section及依赖这些OS
222: 接口的原媒体slab源码。
223: 
224: ### 2.5 16 MB 工程参考
225: 
226: 当前仓库已有 16 MB 布局例子：
227: 
228: - `projects/lvgl/img_decode/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`
229: - `projects/lvgl/freetype_font/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`
230: - `projects/wifi/p2p/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv`
231: 
232: 这些例子证明生成器和 CP ID 检测支持 16 MB，但其内存用途属于各自项目，不能
233: 只复制容量数字而忽略各区域语义。本方案选择与当前 `app_ab` SRAM布局相同的
234: `lvgl/img_decode`/`lvgl/freetype_font`七区域PSRAM表作为正式参考；不采用
235: `wifi/p2p`不同的SRAM和PSRAM比例。

237: 原厂四个媒体slab由以下实现管理：
238: 
239: - 固定映射结构：
240:   `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/frame_buffer_mapping.h:24`
241: - 四个独立best-fit free-list：
242:   `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:77`
243: - PSRAM上电后重建slab：
244:   `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_service/src/media_service.c:115`
245: 
246: OpenVela应保持四个slab、best-fit分配、块合并、统计和上电重建语义，但使用NuttX
247: mutex/spinlock和错误码重写OS适配层，不直接编译依赖FreeRTOS/Beken RTOS API的
248: 原文件。

250: ### 2.6 `vendor_beken` 参考边界
251: 
252: BK7236N 参考配置包含：
253: 
254: ```text
255: CONFIG_PSRAM=y
256: CONFIG_PSRAM_AS_SYS_MEMORY=y
257: CONFIG_PSRAM_HEAP_BASE=0x60000000
258: ```
259: 
260: 见：
261: 
262: `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/bk_idk/armino_as_lib/bk7236n/config/sdkconfig.h:238-245`。
263: 
264: 但 `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_allocateheap.c:117-121` 的
265: `arm_addregion()`仍是空实现。该移植通过预编译 Armino 库使用 PSRAM，不是一个
266: 已完成的 NuttX 外部 heap 参考。可参考其 chip/board 构建组织，不得直接复制其
267: PSRAM 地址、初始化库或把 `CONFIG_PSRAM_AS_SYS_MEMORY`当作 NuttX 已接入的证据。

269: ### 2.7 NuttX 独立 heap 依据
270: 
271: NuttX 提供独立 heap API：
272: 
273: - `mm_initialize()`：`contest/nuttx/include/nuttx/mm/mm.h:274-291`
274: - `mm_malloc()`：同文件 `328-330`
275: - `mm_free()`：同文件 `348-351`
276: - `mm_uninitialize()`：同文件 `304-306`
277: - 代表实现：
278:   `contest/nuttx/arch/risc-v/src/esp32c3-legacy/esp32c3_rtcheap.c:50-78`
279: 
280: BK7258 应采用同类独立 heap，而不是将 PSRAM 并入 `g_mmheap`。这样可以显式区分
281: SRAM 与 PSRAM 指针，提供独立统计，并为 power-off/recovery 保留冻结和重建边界。
282: 
283: ## 3. 目标内存所有权
284: 
285: ### 3.1 Share SRAM 保持不变
286: 
287: BK7258 的 640 KiB 片内 Share SRAM 是 `0x28000000..0x280a0000`，由下列五个
288: 区域完全划分；它不是 OpenVela 可自由分配的 640 KiB。基础 `app_ab` SRAM继续使用：
289: 
290: | 区域 | 半开地址范围 | 大小 | owner |
291: | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
292: | `AP_SPINLOCK` | `0x28000000..0x28010000` | `0x10000`，64 KiB | AP/CP 同步保留 |
293: | `AP_RAM` | `0x28010000..0x28064000` | `0x54000`，336 KiB | OpenVela AP 私有 SRAM |
294: | `CP_RAM` | `0x28064000..0x2809f700` | `0x3b700`，237.75 KiB | Armino CP 私有 SRAM |
295: | `PWR_MNG` | `0x2809f700..0x2809f800` | `0x100`，256 B | 固定 AP/CP ABI |
296: | `SWAP` | `0x2809f800..0x280a0000` | `0x800`，2 KiB | 系统保留 |
297: 
298: `AP_SPINLOCK` 只用于同步与协议保留，不属于可供 AP 动态分配的普通 SRAM。
299: 这里的“私有”表示布局所有权，不表示其他总线master在硬件上必然无法访问；MPU、
300: PPC/MPC和软件指针校验仍需分别限制访问。
301: 
302: PSRAM 改造不得改变 AP Flash 起点、AP 私有 SRAM、Mailbox buffer 或 PWR_MNG 地址。
303: 这样可以把 PSRAM 引入与当前已成功的启动和日志基线隔离。
304: 
305: ### 3.2 PSRAM 正式布局
306: 
307: 目标布局直接采用原厂 `lvgl/img_decode`和`lvgl/freetype_font`的16 MB分配，不
308: 自定义单owner区域。完整 `app_ab/ram_regions.csv`应为：
309: 
310: ```csv
311: # SRAM base addr is 0x28000000, capacity is 640K
312: # PSRAM base addr is 0x60000000
313: PSRAM_CAPCAITY_SIZE=16M
314: #Name,                   Type,     Offset,     Size
315: AP_SPINLOCK,             SRAM, 0x28000000, 0x010000
316: AP_RAM,                  SRAM,           , 0x054000
317: CP_RAM,                  SRAM,           , 0x03b700
318: PWR_MNG,                 SRAM,           , 0x000100
319: SWAP,                    SRAM,           , 0x000800
320: PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_USER,    PSRAM, 0x60000000, 0x019000
321: PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_AUDIO,   PSRAM,           , 0x019000
322: PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_ENCODE,  PSRAM,           , 0x15E000
323: PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_DISPLAY, PSRAM,           , 0x570000
324: CP_PSRAM_HEAP,          PSRAM,           , 0x020000
325: AP_PSRAM_HEAP,          PSRAM,           , 0x2e0000
326: AP_PSRAM_SECTION,       PSRAM,           , 0x600000
327: ```
328: 
329: 生成后的准确边界：
330: 
331: | 区域 | 半开地址范围 | 大小 | owner/用途 |
332: | --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
333: | `PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_USER` | `0x60000000..0x60019000` | 100 KiB | Vela通用媒体pool |
334: | `PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_AUDIO` | `0x60019000..0x60032000` | 100 KiB | Vela音频pool |
335: | `PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_ENCODE` | `0x60032000..0x60190000` | 1400 KiB | Vela编码pool |
336: | `PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_DISPLAY` | `0x60190000..0x60700000` | 5568 KiB | Vela显示/视频帧pool |
337: | `CP_PSRAM_HEAP` | `0x60700000..0x60720000` | 128 KiB | Armino CP system heap |
338: | `AP_PSRAM_HEAP` | `0x60720000..0x60a00000` | 2944 KiB | Vela/AP动态heap |
339: | `AP_PSRAM_SECTION` | `0x60a00000..0x61000000` | 6144 KiB | Vela/AP静态PSRAM section |
340: 
341: 容量汇总：
342: 
343: ```text
344: 媒体 slab总量 = 0x00700000 = 7 MiB
345: AP动态heap     = 0x002e0000 = 2.875 MiB
346: AP静态section  = 0x00600000 = 6 MiB
347: Vela/AP总量    = 0x00fe0000 = 15.875 MiB
348: CP heap        = 0x00020000 = 128 KiB
349: 物理总量       = 0x01000000 = 16 MiB
350: ```
351: 
352: 生成头应至少得到原厂宏：
353: 
354: ```c

356: #define CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY                0x01000000
357: #define CONFIG_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_USER_ADDR      0x60000000

360: #define CONFIG_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_AUDIO_SIZE     0x00019000

362: #define CONFIG_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_ENCODE_SIZE    0x0015e000
363: #define CONFIG_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_DISPLAY_ADDR   0x60190000
364: #define CONFIG_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_DISPLAY_SIZE   0x00570000
365: #define CONFIG_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_ADDR             0x60700000
366: #define CONFIG_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE             0x00020000
367: #define CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_ADDR             0x60720000
368: #define CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE             0x002e0000

370: #define CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_SIZE          0x00600000
371: ```
372: 
373: 必须增加构建断言：
374: 
375: ```text
376: 第一个媒体slab从CONFIG_PSRAM_BASE开始
377: 每个区域起点等于前一区域终点
378: CP_PSRAM_HEAP严格为0x60700000..0x60720000
379: AP_PSRAM_HEAP严格为0x60720000..0x60a00000
380: AP_PSRAM_SECTION终点等于0x61000000
381: 所有区域总量等于CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY

383: 
384: ### 3.3 CP 所有权保持原厂实现
385: 
386: CP继续使用：
387: 
388: ```text
389: CONFIG_PSRAM=y
390: CONFIG_PSRAM_AS_SYS_MEMORY=y
391: CONFIG_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_ADDR=0x60700000
392: CONFIG_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE=0x00020000
393: ```
394: 
395: 无需为Vela修改 CP linker和 FreeRTOS `heap_4.c`的基本布局。必须保证：
396: 
397: 1. CP只能从自己的128 KiB heap分配。
398: 2. CP不得把AP heap、AP section或媒体slab加入自己的allocator。
399: 3. CP异常dump若读取AP区域必须只读，并在AP停止后执行。
400: 4. CP的PSRAM使用计数和低功耗投票继续有效。
401: 5. CP map中 `PSRAM_HEAP`只能声明为 `0x60700000/0x20000`；map中的`0 B used`
402:    只表示没有链接期section落入该region，不代表运行时heap未启用或未分配。
403: 
404: ### 3.4 OpenVela 按原厂区域建立 allocator
405: 
406: 不能跨过CP heap建立一个覆盖多个非连续区域的单一heap。OpenVela应分别管理：
407: 
408: 1. 四个媒体slab：保持原厂地址、用途和独立best-fit free-list语义。
409: 2. `AP_PSRAM_HEAP`：使用独立 `mm_heap_s`作为AP通用动态PSRAM heap。
410: 3. `AP_PSRAM_SECTION`：保留给链接期静态对象，不进入动态allocator。
411: 
412: 首版逻辑策略：
413: 
414: | 用途 | 首版策略 |
415: | --- | --- |
416: | 普通AP大对象 | 从 `AP_PSRAM_HEAP`分配 |
417: | 通用媒体控制buffer | 从 USER slab分配 |
418: | 音频 ring/workspace | 从 AUDIO slab分配 |
419: | 编码输入输出/workspace | 从 ENCODE slab分配 |
420: | 帧缓冲和显示buffer | 从 DISPLAY slab分配 |
421: | DMA buffer | 从对应用途pool对齐分配，记录DMA owner和方向 |
422: | 经审计静态大对象 | 链接到 `AP_PSRAM_SECTION` |
423: | 内核对象和任务栈 | 默认留在 SRAM |
424: 
425: 不得为了提高某一阶段可用量而动态吞并相邻区域。若后续确需调整比例，必须修改
426: 项目 `ram_regions.csv`、重新生成AP/CP统一布局并执行完整回归，不能在运行时改
427: 边界。
428: 
429: ## 4. 启动与初始化时序
430: 
431: ### 4.1 CP 阶段
432: 
433: 目标启动时序：
434: 
435: ```text
436: Bootloader
437:   -> Armino CP
438:      -> bk_init()
439:         -> driver_init()
440:            -> bk_psram_init()
441:               -> 电压/LDO/时钟
442:               -> 控制器初始化
443:               -> 16 MB 器件 ID 检测
444:               -> 记录 actual_id 和 actual_capacity
445:      -> 启动 OpenVela AP
446: ```
447: 
448: CP 在启动 AP 前必须具备可查询状态：
449: 
450: ```c
451: struct bk_psram_status
452: {
453:   uint32_t initialized;
454:   uint32_t device_id;
455:   uint32_t capacity;
456:   uint32_t clock_hz;
457:   uint32_t generation;
458:   int32_t  last_error;
459: };
460: ```
461: 
462: 结构不应由 AP 直接读取 CP 私有全局变量。优先通过正式 PWC query/response返回；
463: 如使用 `PWR_MNG` 固定 ABI，必须分配版本号、长度、校验和和明确 owner，并与 CP
464: 同步修改，不能覆盖现有固定字。
465: 
466: ### 4.2 OpenVela reset 阶段
467: 
468: OpenVela reset handler只做：
469: 
470: - 建立 SAU/MPU、FPU、C runtime 和 runtime vectors。
471: - 配置 PSRAM MPU region。首版无论 `AP_PSRAM_SECTION` 是否预留，都不在 reset 阶段建立 allocator、搬移对象或触碰未经确认就绪的静态 PSRAM 数据。
472: - 不创建 allocator。
473: - 不清零整颗PSRAM、媒体pool、AP heap或CP heap。
474: - 不等待 PWC semaphore。
475: 
476: 后续启用 `.psram.data/.psram.bss`时，reset阶段只允许在CP已保证PSRAM上电后复制
477: 或清零 `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`内实际section范围；这属于第9章的独立门禁，
478: 不改变其他区域。
479: 
480: 不能在 `bk7258_start()` 中调用 `mm_initialize()`，因为此时 NuttX scheduler、锁和
481: 完整内存基础设施尚未启动。
482: 
483: ### 4.3 Board late 阶段
484: 
485: 在当前 Mailbox、heartbeat 和 PWC worker完成后执行：
486: 
487: ```text
488: board_late_initialize()
489:   -> Mailbox/PWC transport ready
490:   -> 查询 CP PSRAM status
491:   -> 校验 initialized == 1
492:   -> 校验 capacity == 0x01000000
493:   -> 获取 AP PSRAM power lease
494:   -> 执行 non-destructive 边界/alias probe
495:   -> 首次开发构建只测试Vela/AP拥有的六个区域
496:   -> 初始化四个媒体pool和AP动态heap
497:   -> 注册 /proc 或 NSH 诊断入口
498:   -> 标记 PSRAM ONLINE
499: ```
500: 
501: PSRAM 初始化失败不应破坏当前 AP 启动和 Mailbox heartbeat。开发阶段允许 AP
502: 进入 `DEGRADED_SRAM_ONLY` 并输出明确错误，但音视频服务必须拒绝启动。正式媒体
503: 构建可配置为 PSRAM 失败即阻止 AP ready。
504: 
505: ### 4.4 Ready 语义
506: 
507: 定义两种配置：
508: 
509: 1. `CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED=y`：只有 PSRAM ONLINE 后才发送 AP ready。
510: 2. 调试内核配置：AP 基础 ready不依赖 PSRAM，但单独发送/打印
511:    `PSRAM unavailable`，媒体服务不得启动。
512: 
513: 后续音视频正式配置必须选择 `PSRAM_REQUIRED`。否则 CP 看到 AP ready 后启动
514: 媒体业务，可能立即因 SRAM不足失败。
515: 
516: ## 5. PWC 协议与状态机
517: 
518: ### 5.1 不能只处理 transport ACK
519: 
520: 当前 `bk7258_pm_pwc.c:89-93` 对 PSRAM power、allocator query 和 recovery命令
521: 直接 `break`，没有业务语义。正式实现必须区分：
522: 
523: - Mailbox transport ACK：只表示消息已接收。
524: - PWC semantic response：表示电源或 allocator操作成功、失败或 busy。
525: 
526: 现有命令号必须保持兼容：
527: 
528: | command | 当前方向和字段 | OpenVela处理 |
529: | ---: | --- | --- |
530: | `0x7 PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD` | AP -> CP请求：`param1=module`、`param2=power_state`；当前CP响应：`param1=power_state` | 保留现有字段，不塞入容量信息；等待CP响应，并在后续扩展中增加明确错误字段而不是只回显状态 |
531: | `0x8 PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD` | CP -> AP查询：`param1=using_psram_type`；AP -> CP响应：`param1=0x8`、`param2=used_count` | 首先兼容`using_psram_type==0`的原厂动态heap计数；媒体pool另由模块vote保护，扩展其他type前同步修改两侧 |
532: | `0x9 PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD` | CP -> AP | 只投递 worker生成统计，不在 ISR执行 dump |
533: | `0xa PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD` | CP -> AP | 冻结 allocator、停止 DMA并返回 busy/success |
534: | `0xc PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD` | AP -> CP查询一项 PM 数据 | 优先扩展 data type分别查询 PSRAM initialized、device ID、capacity、clock和 generation |
535: 
536: 一条 PWC logical message只有 command和三个 `uint32_t`参数，不能假设一次响应可以
537: 携带完整 `bk_psram_status`。正式实现优先在现有 `PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD`下增加多个
538: PSRAM data type，并逐项查询；如果新增专用 status command，必须同步修改 AP/CP
539: header、版本和负向兼容测试，不能只修改 OpenVela一侧。
540: 
541: ### 5.2 状态定义
542: 
543: OpenVela 维护：
544: 
545: ```text
546: OFF
547:   -> POWER_REQUESTED
548:   -> PROBING
549:   -> ONLINE
550:   -> FREEZING
551:   -> OFFLINE
552:   -> RECOVERING
553:   -> FAILED
554: ```
555: 
556: 状态、指向heap的全局指针、outstanding count、generation和last error放在AP私有
557: 片内SRAM，不能放在PSRAM中。默认`mm_initialize()`建立的`struct mm_heap_s`控制块
558: 本身位于`AP_PSRAM_HEAP`头部；PSRAM掉电或offline后只能检查/清空片内SRAM中的
559: 指针，不能再解引用该控制块。
560: 
561: 必须分别记录AP动态heap和四个媒体pool的outstanding。命令`0x8`在
562: `using_psram_type==0`时保持原厂动态heap计数语义，并按原厂格式用响应`param1=0x8`、
563: `param2=used_count`返回；不能擅自改成五个allocator的合计值，否则CP现有低功耗
564: 判断含义改变。
565: 媒体pool由对应audio/encode/display等模块vote保护；未映射到现有模块的USER pool
566: 增加Vela专用lease。`AP_PSRAM_SECTION`只要存在运行期有效静态对象，就在整个AP
567: 生命周期持有常驻lease，不允许PSRAM动态掉电。
568: 
569: ### 5.3 Power-on
570: 
571: ```text
572: AP -> CP: PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD(ON)
573: CP:
574:   -> 增加 OpenVela module vote
575:   -> 若未初始化则执行 CP owner 初始化
576:   -> 用命令0x7返回 power semantic status
577: AP:
578:   -> 用命令0xc逐项查询 initialized、device ID、actual capacity和generation
579:   -> 校验 capacity == 16 MB
580:   -> memory barriers
581:   -> probe
582:   -> 初始化 heap
583:   -> ONLINE
584: ```
585: 
586: 不得依赖未定义的异步广播，也不得在请求发送后立即访问 PSRAM。
587: 
588: ### 5.4 Power-off
589: 
590: ```text
591: CP/AP 请求关闭
592:   -> AP 状态切到 FREEZING
593:   -> 拒绝新分配
594:   -> 等待在途 DMA 和媒体 owner 释放
595:   -> 检查AP heap及四个媒体pool outstanding均为0
596:   -> 检查CP heap count为0
597:   -> 检查全部active lease为0
598:   -> 分别销毁媒体pool和AP mm_heap_s
599:   -> 清各allocator handle
600:   -> AP semantic response SUCCESS
601:   -> CP 关闭控制器/时钟/电源
602: ```
603: 
604: 任一引用存在时返回 `BUSY`，禁止强制断电。`AP_PSRAM_SECTION`存在有效静态对象时
605: 直接视为常驻busy。首个音视频调试版本建议持续持有一个OpenVela system lease，
606: 使CP不执行自动掉电。
607: 
608: ### 5.5 Recovery
609: 
610: CP 发出 AP recovery 或 PSRAM掉电通知时：
611: 
612: 1. 停止音视频 producer。
613: 2. 停止 DMA，等待硬件 idle。
614: 3. 冻结 allocator。
615: 4. 将全部现存 PSRAM 指针视为失效。
616: 5. 增加 generation。
617: 6. allocator outstanding 非零时记录泄漏并拒绝无损恢复。
618: 7. CP 重新上电后重新 probe 和 `mm_initialize()`。
619: 8. 上层服务必须重建 buffer，不得复用旧地址。
620: 
621: generation 应随诊断 API 暴露。调试版本可以在 allocation header 或 owner表记录
622: generation，帮助发现跨 recovery 的 stale pointer。
623: 
624: ## 6. OpenVela 驱动与 API
625: 
626: ### 6.1 文件结构
627: 
628: 在现有 BK7258 chip port 最小新增：
629: 
630: ```text
631: chips/bk7258/
632: ├── bk7258_psram.c
633: ├── bk7258_psram.h
634: └── hardware/
635:     └── bk7258_psram.h
636: ```
637: 
638: 修改：
639: 
640: ```text
641: chips/bk7258/Kconfig
642: chips/bk7258/CMakeLists.txt
643: chips/bk7258/Make.defs
644: chips/bk7258/bk7258_start.c
645: chips/bk7258/bk7258_pm_pwc.c
646: chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_memorymap.h
647: boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c
648: boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh/defconfig

650: 
651: 若生成布局头由 board 层提供，chip 层通过一个最小稳定接口获取
652: `BOARD_PSRAM_START/SIZE`，不要直接包含整个 Armino `sdkconfig.h`。
653: 
654: ### 6.2 Kconfig
655: 
656: 建议增加：
657: 
658: ```kconfig
659: config BK7258_PSRAM
660:     bool "BK7258 CP-managed PSRAM"
661:     default n
662: 
663: config BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
664:     bool "Require PSRAM before AP ready"
665:     depends on BK7258_PSRAM
666: 
667: config BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE
668:     hex "PSRAM size"
669:     default 0x01000000
670:     depends on BK7258_PSRAM
671: 
672: config BK7258_PSRAM_MEMORY_TEST
673:     bool "Run destructive PSRAM test before heap init"
674:     depends on BK7258_PSRAM
675: 
676: config BK7258_PSRAM_KEEP_POWERED
677:     bool "Keep PSRAM powered while AP runs"
678:     default y
679:     depends on BK7258_PSRAM
680: ```
681: 
682: 最终配置：
683: 
684: ```text
685: CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM=y
686: CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED=y
687: CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_SIZE=0x01000000
688: CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_KEEP_POWERED=y
689: CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=1
690: ```
691: 
692: 保持 `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=1` 是有意设计：PSRAM 不进入通用 heap。
693: 
694: ### 6.3 Public API
695: 
696: 建议提供：
697: 
698: ```c
699: int bk7258_psram_initialize(void);
700: int bk7258_psram_shutdown(void);
701: bool bk7258_psram_is_online(void);
702: 
703: void *bk7258_psram_malloc(size_t size);
704: void *bk7258_psram_zalloc(size_t size);
705: void *bk7258_psram_calloc(size_t n, size_t elem_size);
706: void *bk7258_psram_realloc(void *ptr, size_t size);
707: void *bk7258_psram_memalign(size_t alignment, size_t size);
708: void bk7258_psram_free(void *ptr);
709: 
710: void *bk7258_media_pool_alloc(enum bk7258_psram_pool pool,
711:                               size_t alignment, size_t size);
712: void bk7258_media_pool_free(enum bk7258_psram_pool pool, void *ptr);
713: 
714: int bk7258_psram_info(struct bk7258_psram_info *info);
715: bool bk7258_psram_contains(const void *ptr, size_t size);
716: ```
717: 
718: 接口约束：
719: 
720: - `size == 0`行为与 NuttX `mm_*`保持一致并写入接口文档。
721: - `calloc`检查乘法溢出。
722: - `contains`检查指针加法溢出和半开区间上限。
723: - allocator 不在线或冻结时分配返回 `NULL`并设置明确 errno。
724: - 通用 `free`只接受 `AP_PSRAM_HEAP`指针；媒体pool指针必须交给对应pool释放。
725: - 任一API都检查指针所属原厂区域，禁止跨过CP heap释放或合并块。
726: - `memalign`支持至少 32 字节 cache line、DMA 和 framebuffer要求。
727: - 所有 API 在 SMP 下必须依赖 NuttX `mm_heap_s`内部锁和额外状态锁，不能只用
728:   `up_irq_save()`保护全局状态。
729: 
730: ### 6.4 allocator 实现
731: 
732: 核心流程：
733: 
734: ```c
735: g_psram_heap = mm_initialize("bk7258-ap-psram",
736:                              (void *)CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_ADDR,
737:                              CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE);
738: ```
739: 
740: 四个媒体slab不加入 `g_psram_heap`。按原厂 `psram_mem_slab.c`移植四个独立
741: best-fit free-list，保留块拆分、相邻空闲块合并、使用量统计和
742: `USER/AUDIO/ENCODE/DISPLAY`类型检查；锁和初始化生命周期改用NuttX机制。禁止
743: 把四段交给一个可跨区域分配的heap。
744: 
745: 包装 API 使用：
746: 
747: ```text
748: mm_malloc
749: mm_zalloc
750: mm_calloc
751: mm_realloc
752: mm_memalign
753: mm_free
754: mm_mallinfo
755: mm_malloc_size
756: mm_uninitialize
757: ```
758: 
759: `struct mm_heap_s`控制块由`mm_initialize()`放在`AP_PSRAM_HEAP`头部，因此allocator
760: offline后不能再解引用它。指向它的全局指针和状态保存在AP私有SRAM；shutdown时
761: 必须在PSRAM仍上电且allocator已冻结时完成统计和泄漏检查，再调用
762: `mm_uninitialize()`，最后清空片内SRAM中的指针。
763: 
764: ### 6.5 统计与诊断
765: 
766: `bk7258_psram_info` 至少包含：
767: 
768: ```c
769: struct bk7258_psram_info
770: {
771:   uintptr_t base;
772:   size_t capacity;
773:   size_t arena;
774:   size_t allocated;
775:   size_t free;
776:   size_t largest_free;
777:   size_t peak_allocated;
778:   uint32_t allocation_count;
779:   uint32_t failed_allocations;
780:   uint32_t generation;
781:   uint32_t state;
782:   uint32_t device_id;
783:   int last_error;
784: };
785: ```
786: 
787: 提供 NSH 或 procfs 节点，例如：
788: 
789: ```text
790: psram info
791: psram test quick
792: psram test full
793: psram stress <seconds>
794: ```
795: 
796: 不得在生产运行期间执行破坏性AP区域测试；Vela任何时候都不得测试CP heap。
797: 
798: ## 7. MPU、SAU 与执行权限
799: 
800: ### 7.1 MPU region
801: 
802: 在 `bk7258_start.c` 增加：
803: 
804: ```c
805: {
806:   0x60000000u,
807:   0x01000000u,
808:   MPU_RBAR_XN | MPU_RBAR_AP_RWRW | MPU_RBAR_SH_INNER,
809:   MPU_RLAR_NONCACHEABLE
810: }
811: ```
812: 
813: 要求：
814: 
815: - 精确覆盖 16 MB，不覆盖控制器的 64 MB映射窗口。
816: - RW、XN，禁止默认从 PSRAM执行代码。
817: - 首版 non-cacheable。
818: - CPU1+CPU2 SMP 时两个核配置一致。
819: - 所有正式 API和测试工具必须拒绝 `0x61000000`及之后地址。
820: 
821: 当前 `mpu_initialize(..., false, true)`启用了 privileged default map，因此“没有
822: 显式 PSRAM region”不等于 privileged代码越界必然触发 MemManageFault。若验收
823: 要求硬件 fault隔离，必须关闭 `PRIVDEFENA`并补齐所有必要 region，或增加一个
824: 更高优先级的 `0x61000000..0x63ffffff` no-access region；具体 no-access编码和
825: region优先级需按当前 ARMv8-M MPU公共实现验证。首版至少由 API边界、DMA长度和
826: 测试命令三层阻止越界，不能把未验证的 fault写成既定行为。
827: 
828: 当前配置声明 `CONFIG_ARM_MPU_NREGIONS=8`，启用PSRAM后的现有代码使用4个region：
829: Flash、AP私有SRAM、PSRAM和外设窗口，仍在配置数量范围内。但必须从MPU TYPE
830: 寄存器实板确认硬件region数量；SAU region不计入MPU region数量。
831: 
832: ### 7.2 SAU 风险门禁
833: 
834: 当前 `bk7258_start.c:77-83` 的 SAU写值与注释存在疑点：region 0的 RLAR bit 1
835: 会设置 NSC，region 1 又覆盖 AP RAM和 PSRAM地址范围。PSRAM接入前必须：
836: 
837: 1. 导出 golden AVDK AP 的 SAU RNR/RBAR/RLAR/CTRL。
838: 2. 导出 OpenVela 同一寄存器。
839: 3. 结合 BK7258 IDAU/PPC/MPC定义确认 Secure alias实际属性。
840: 4. 确认 `0x60000000..0x60ffffff` 对 CPU1和媒体 DMA master可访问。
841: 5. 对错误安全属性执行 SecureFault负向测试。
842: 
843: 未完成前只称“功能性 PSRAM访问”，不能声称 TrustZone隔离正确。
844: 
845: ### 7.3 不执行代码
846: 
847: 首版禁止：
848: 
849: - `.psram.text`、`.ramfunc`指向 PSRAM。
850: - 从 PSRAM加载插件或 codec代码。
851: - 将函数指针跳转到 PSRAM。
852: - 将整个 PSRAM MPU region改为可执行。
853: 
854: 若后续确需 PSRAM code，必须建立独立小型 RO/RX region、签名/完整性校验、copy
855: table、cache维护和链接断言，不改变数据 heap的 XN属性。
856: 
857: ## 8. Cache、DMA 与 SMP 一致性
858: 
859: ### 8.1 首版 non-cacheable
860: 
861: AVDK AP 的 `mpu_cfg.c:121-124` 将 PSRAM设为 Normal non-cacheable、XN。OpenVela
862: 首版沿用该属性，原因是：
863: 
864: - 音视频 DMA 会直接读写 PSRAM。
865: - AP/CP和未来 CPU1/CPU2可能共享数据。
866: - 当前没有完整 cache clean/invalidate ownership协议。
867: - Mailbox和媒体驱动尚未统一 cache line对齐规则。
868: 
869: 性能可能低于 cacheable模式，但正确性优先。
870: 
871: ### 8.2 DMA API
872: 
873: 媒体驱动不能把普通 `bk7258_psram_malloc()` 返回值无条件交给 DMA。建议提供：
874: 
875: ```c
876: void *bk7258_psram_dma_alloc(size_t size, size_t alignment,
877:                              enum dma_data_direction dir);
878: void bk7258_psram_dma_free(void *ptr);
879: ```
880: 
881: 首版 non-cacheable时 sync操作为空 barrier，但 API仍保留：
882: 
883: ```c
884: bk7258_psram_sync_for_device(ptr, size, dir);
885: bk7258_psram_sync_for_cpu(ptr, size, dir);
886: ```
887: 
888: 这样后续启用 cache时不需要修改全部音视频调用者。
889: 
890: 必须验证每个硬件 master：
891: 
892: - 是否能访问 Secure PSRAM alias `0x60000000`。
893: - 地址是否需要其他 bus alias。
894: - 最大传输长度和边界限制。
895: - 对齐、burst和二维 stride要求。
896: - DMA completion后 CPU可见性。
897: 
898: ### 8.3 Cacheable 后续阶段
899: 
900: 只有满足以下条件后才评估 cacheable PSRAM：
901: 
902: - CPU1/CPU2共享属性确认。
903: - D-cache line size实测并固定。
904: - allocator至少按 cache line对齐关键对象。
905: - DMA map/unmap和双向 sync接口全部接入。
906: - AP/CP共享对象有明确 owner handoff。
907: - 24小时音视频压力无 stale data、tearing或随机 codec错误。
908: 
909: 不能只把 MPU attribute从 non-cacheable改为 write-back而不修改驱动。
910: 
911: ## 9. 链接与静态 section
912: 
913: ### 9.1 AP PSRAM section
914: 
915: OpenVela链接脚本必须保留原厂 `AP_PSRAM_SECTION`边界：
916: 
917: ```ld
918: PSRAM_SECTION (rw) : ORIGIN = CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_ADDR,
919:                      LENGTH = CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_SIZE
920: 
921: __ap_psram_section_start = ORIGIN(PSRAM_SECTION);
922: __ap_psram_section_end = ORIGIN(PSRAM_SECTION) + LENGTH(PSRAM_SECTION);
923: ```
924: 
925: 首次allocator提交可以先不放对象，但不得将这6 MiB并入AP heap。后续静态对象只
926: 允许显式标注到：
927: 
928: ```text
929: .psram.data
930: .psram.bss
931: .psram.noinit
932: ```
933: 
934: `.psram.text`首版仍禁止。启用静态section前必须确认CP在释放AP reset前已完成
935: PSRAM初始化；OpenVela reset handler先建立PSRAM MPU属性，再复制 `.psram.data`、
936: 清零 `.psram.bss`。如果启动链不能保证PSRAM已上电，则静态section保持为空，
937: 不能在board late阶段补初始化已经可能被C代码访问的全局对象。
938: 
939: ### 9.2 链接断言
940: 
941: 增加：
942: 
943: ```ld
944: ASSERT(CONFIG_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_ADDR == 0x60700000, "CP PSRAM heap base mismatch")
945: ASSERT(CONFIG_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE == 0x00020000, "CP PSRAM heap size mismatch")
946: ASSERT(CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_ADDR == 0x60720000, "AP PSRAM heap base mismatch")
947: ASSERT(CONFIG_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_SIZE == 0x002e0000, "AP PSRAM heap size mismatch")
948: ASSERT(__ap_psram_section_start == 0x60a00000, "AP PSRAM section base mismatch")
949: ASSERT(__ap_psram_section_end == 0x61000000, "16 MB layout end mismatch")
950: ```
951: 
952: 构建后扫描所有alloc section：只有经过批准的 `.psram.data/.psram.bss/.psram.noinit`
953: 可以落入 `AP_PSRAM_SECTION`；媒体slab、CP heap和AP动态heap不能出现链接期对象。
954: 
955: ## 10. 构建系统与布局单一来源
956: 
957: ### 10.1 目标依赖链
958: 
959: 正式依赖链：
960: 
961: ```text
962: projects/app_ab/partitions/bk7258/ram_regions.csv
963:   -> BK ram region generator
964:   -> ram_regions.h
965:   -> validate/convert_bk7258_layout
966:   -> bk7258_openvela_layout.h
967:   -> OpenVela C/MPU配置和 ld.script预处理
968:   -> OpenVela AP ELF/raw
969:   -> EXTERNAL_AP_BIN
970:   -> Beken packager
971:   -> all-app.bin
972: ```
973: 
974: `bk7258_openvela_layout.h` 只导出：
975: 
976: ```c
977: BK7258_AP_RAM_BASE/SIZE
978: BK7258_CP_RAM_BASE/SIZE
979: BK7258_PWR_MNG_BASE/SIZE
980: BK7258_PSRAM_CAPACITY
981: BK7258_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_USER_BASE/SIZE
982: BK7258_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_AUDIO_BASE/SIZE
983: BK7258_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_ENCODE_BASE/SIZE
984: BK7258_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_DISPLAY_BASE/SIZE
985: BK7258_CP_PSRAM_HEAP_BASE/SIZE
986: BK7258_AP_PSRAM_HEAP_BASE/SIZE
987: BK7258_AP_PSRAM_SECTION_BASE/SIZE
988: ```
989: 
990: 不要把整个 `ram_regions.h` 或 Armino `sdkconfig.h`直接 include进 NuttX，避免宏
991: 冲突和将 CP配置泄漏到 AP构建。
992: 
993: ### 10.2 当前两步构建的处理
994: 
995: 当前流程先构建 OpenVela，再构建 `app_ab`。这会导致 OpenVela无法自然消费本次
996: Armino构建生成的 layout。实施期有两种方式：
997: 
998: 1. 推荐：增加独立 `generate-layout`步骤，在两个工程构建前生成并校验 header。
999: 2. 过渡：从受版本控制的 `ram_regions.csv`运行转换脚本生成 OpenVela header，
1000:    CP构建后再比较其 `ram_regions.h`，不一致则失败。
1001: 
1002: 禁止直接复制上一次 `build/.../ram_regions.h`，因为增量构建可能使用旧的 8 MB
1003: 结果。
1004: 
1005: `projects/app_ab/build/.../armino/partitions/_build/ram_regions.csv`、`ram_regions.h`
1006: 和预处理后的链接脚本都属于构建产物，不是布局单一来源；当 `ram_regions.csv`
1007: 或配置文件变化时，必须执行项目级 clean 重新生成。
1008: 
1009: ### 10.3 构建门禁
1010: 
1011: 以下任一条件必须使构建失败：
1012: 
1013: - CSV容量不是 `16M`。
1014: - 生成 `CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY`不是 `0x01000000`。
1015: - 七个原厂区域任一地址或大小与第3.2节不一致。
1016: - 区域不连续、重叠，或总终点不是 `0x61000000`。
1017: - CP未启用128 KiB `CP_PSRAM_HEAP`，或CP map越过该区域。
1018: - OpenVela动态heap或媒体pool覆盖 `0x60700000..0x6071ffff`。
1019: - OpenVela的非PSRAM section或未经批准对象落入PSRAM。
1020: - `.psram.*`对象超出 `0x60a00000..0x60ffffff`。
1021: - OpenVela MPU配置长度不是 16 MB。
1022: - OpenVela配置意外设置 `CONFIG_MM_REGIONS > 1`并把 PSRAM加入通用 heap。
1023: - AP/CP生成头的容量、base或size不一致。
1024: - 顶层、CP核内和AP核内`_build/ram_regions.csv`或预处理链接脚本任一仍为旧布局。
1025: - 最终`package/tmp/app1.bin`与指定的OpenVela `nuttx.bin`不一致。
1026: 
1027: ## 11. 实施步骤
1028: 
1029: ### 阶段 0：冻结现有 SRAM-only 基线
1030: 
1031: 保存：
1032: 
1033: - 当前 OpenVela `nuttx`、`nuttx.bin`、`System.map`和 `.config`。
1034: - 当前 `all-app.bin`、CP map和 generated `ram_regions.h`。
1035: - 20次启动日志、Mailbox heartbeat和 NSH日志。
1036: - 当前 SRAM `free`、任务列表和栈使用情况。
1037: 
1038: 退出条件：现有 AP启动和日志连续复位20次通过。
1039: 
1040: ### 阶段 1：建立 16 MB CP 硬件基线
1041: 
1042: 1. 暂时保持原 AVDK AP，使用一个已存在的 16 MB工程验证器件。
1043: 2. 记录 CP 检测到的 PSRAM device ID和 capacity。
1044: 3. 执行0、4 MiB、8 MiB、12 MiB边界和最后有效word测试；16 MiB偏移
1045:    `0x61000000`只做受控非法边界/alias负向验证，不作为器件内地址写入。
1046: 4. 执行地址线 alias测试，证明后 8 MB不是前 8 MB镜像。
1047: 5. 记录 80/120 MHz下读写稳定性和错误率。
1048: 
1049: 退出条件：实板确认可稳定访问 `0x60000000..0x60ffffff`，且
1050: `0x61000000`不属于器件。
1051: 
1052: ### 阶段 2：切换 `app_ab` 原厂16 MB布局
1053: 
1054: 1. 将容量改为 16 MB。
1055: 2. 按 `lvgl/img_decode`复制七个PSRAM区域的大小和顺序。
1056: 3. 保留CP 128 KiB heap及 `PSRAM_AS_SYS_MEMORY`。
1057: 4. 生成并校验全部AP/CP区域宏。

1297: ## 14. 音视频移植使用规则
1298: 
1299: 后续组件必须遵循：
1300:

1303: 3. 所有 DMA buffer使用 DMA专用 PSRAM API。
1304: 4. 每个媒体服务持有明确 power lease。
1305: 5. 服务停止顺序固定为 producer停止、DMA停止、consumer drain、释放 buffer、
1306:    释放 lease。
1307: 6. codec预编译库若内部调用 `psram_malloc`，通过明确 OS ABI wrapper映射到
1308:    `bk7258_psram_*`，不得映射到 `kmm_malloc`。
1309: 7. 对每个预编译库检查 `.psram.*`、固定地址和 FreeRTOS符号，禁止未审计接入。
1310: 8. framebuffer和媒体代码不直接散落硬编码地址；各pool base/size来自生成布局，
1311:    对象地址来自对应pool allocator。
1312: 9. 驱动不得缓存跨 recovery有效的裸 PSRAM指针。
1313: 10. 内存不足时返回明确错误并降级分辨率、buffer数量或 codec配置，不能回退到
1314:     片内 SRAM大块分配导致内核失稳。

1316: ## 15. 主要风险与决策
1317: 
1318: | 风险 | 后果 | 处理 |
1319: | --- | --- | --- |
1320: | 实物不是16 MB或ID异常 | 后8 MB访问镜像/损坏 | ID、地址线和全容量实测，失败禁用 heap |
1321: | 只改CSV容量或只看顶层生成头 | CP/AP核内仍按旧heap宏构建 | 项目级clean，逐层核对临时CSV、生成头和链接脚本 |
1322: | Vela覆盖CP 128 KiB heap | AP/CP allocator互相破坏 | 保留原厂边界并做map/运行时指针检查 |
1323: | AP重复初始化PHY | 电压/时钟冲突 | CP唯一owner，AP只通过PWC请求 |
1324: | PSRAM加入通用heap | 掉电时无法证明无引用 | 使用独立 `mm_heap_s` |
1325: | reset阶段访问AP section时电源未就绪 | 启动立即fault | 确认CP先初始化；否则静态section保持为空 |
1326: | 容量不匹配只告警 | 越过真实器件边界 | semantic query严格校验，失败不上线 |
1327: | cache过早启用 | DMA/双核读取旧数据 | 首版non-cacheable，预留sync API |
1328: | DMA安全属性不匹配 | SecureFault或静默不工作 | 逐master验证SAU/PPC/MPC和alias |
1329: | active对象时掉电 | 音视频随机崩溃 | lease、freeze、outstanding和busy响应 |
1330: | AP/CP reset不同步 | stale pointer和旧数据 | generation与服务重建 |
1331: | 错把分区布局当成单heap | 跨CP区合并和内存破坏 | AP heap与四个媒体pool分别管理 |
1332: | SMP只关闭本地IRQ | allocator状态竞争 | NuttX heap锁和SMP-safe状态锁 |
1333: | SAU当前配置可疑 | 访问属性和安全边界错误 | golden寄存器对比后再验收 |

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 PWC worker and CPU1 ready handshake.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: 
9: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
10: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
11: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
12: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
13: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
14: 
15: int bk7258_mailbox_init(void);
16: int bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(uint8_t command, uint32_t p1, uint32_t p2,
17:                             uint32_t p3);
18: void bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(void (*callback)(const void *message));
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
20: 
21: #define PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD 0x5u
22: #define PM_QUEUE_DEPTH 8u
23: 
24: struct pwc_message
25: {
26:   uint32_t header;
27:   uint32_t param1;
28:   uint32_t param2;
29:   uint32_t param3;
30: };
31: 
32: static struct pwc_message g_queue[PM_QUEUE_DEPTH];
33: static volatile unsigned int g_head;
34: static volatile unsigned int g_tail;
35: static sem_t g_pwc_sem;
36: static sem_t g_worker_sem;
37: static volatile bool g_worker_ready;
38: static volatile bool g_ready_sent;
39: 
40: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
41: {
42:   static uint32_t heartbeat_payload;
43: 
44:   (void)argc;
45:   (void)argv;
46:   for (;;)
47:     {
48:       nxsig_usleep(2000000);
49:       (void)bk7258_mbox_send_message(2, 0x10,
50:                                      (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&heartbeat_payload,
51:                                      sizeof(heartbeat_payload), 0);
52:     }
53:   return 0;
54: }
55: 
56: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
57: {
58:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
59:   struct pwc_message message;
60:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
61:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
62:     {
63:       return;
64:     }
65:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
66:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
67:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
68:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
69:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
70:   g_head = next;
71:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
72: }
73: 
74: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
75: {
76:   (void)argc;
77:   (void)argv;
78:   g_worker_ready = true;
79:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
80:   for (;;)
81:     {
82:       struct pwc_message message;
83:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
84:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
85:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
86:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
87:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
88:         {
89:           case 0x7u: /* PSRAM power request: CP owns the PHY transition. */
90:           case 0xau: /* AP recovery request. */
91:           case 0x8u: /* allocator state query. */
92:           case 0x9u: /* allocator diagnostics query. */
93:             break;
94:           default:
95:             break;
96:         }
97:     }
98:   return 0;
99: }
100: 
101: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
102: {
103:   int pid;
104:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
105:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
106:   g_head = 0;
107:   g_tail = 0;
108:   g_worker_ready = false;
109:   g_ready_sent = false;
110:   pid = bk7258_mailbox_init();
111:   if (pid < 0)
112:     {
113:       return pid;
114:     }
115:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
116:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
117:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
118:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
119:     {
120:       return -1;
121:     }
122:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
123:                      NULL) < 0)
124:     {
125:       return -1;
126:     }
127:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
128:   if (pid < 0)
129:     {
130:       return pid;
131:     }
132:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
133:       !g_worker_ready)
134:     {
135:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
136:     }
137:   if (!g_ready_sent)
138:     {
139:       g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD, 1, 0, 0) == 0;
140:     }
141:   if (g_ready_sent)
142:     {
143:       return 0;
144:     }
145: 
146:   return -1;
147: }

<task id="ses_048a95043ffeD5GykwmDmXkWle" state="completed">
<task_result>
## Scope and conclusion

The BK7258 AP/CP power-control protocol is carried on mailbox logical channel `MB_CHNL_PWC`. Its application payload is a fixed 16-byte message:

```c
header/mb_chnl_hdr_t
param1
param2
param3
```

Commands `0x7`, `0x8`, `0x9`, and `0xa` participate directly or indirectly in PSRAM ownership/lifetime management. Command `0xc` is a generic AP-to-CP PM-data query and does **not** expose PSRAM state, device ID, or capacity.

The most important compatibility findings are:

1. In current `bk_avdk_smp`, command `0x7` does **not** return `bk_err_t` in `param1`; CP returns the requested `pm_power_module_state_e` (`0` on, `1` off). This differs from older `bk_idk`.
2. Command `0x8` is overloaded:
   - `param1 == 0`: request AP allocator usage, followed by a command-`0x8` semantic response.
   - `param1 == 1`: asynchronous “PSRAM powered off” notification; no semantic response is expected.
3. Command `0x9` requests allocator diagnostics and has no semantic response.
4. Command `0xa` is the AP-recovery/shutdown callback mechanism, not a PSRAM-information query.
5. Command `0xc` only supports three PM data selectors: startup interval, deep-sleep wake source, and low-voltage wake source.
6. The CP PSRAM driver internally knows initialization state and detected ID, but current `bk_avdk_smp` does not export either through PWC, and does not expose public ID/capacity getters.
7. A detected/configured capacity mismatch is only logged as a warning. Initialization still succeeds, and the compile-time memory map is not clamped to actual capacity.

---

# 1. Wire format and mailbox synchronization

## 1.1 Exact wire data types

The AP mailbox definition is:

- `mb_chnl_hdr_t`: 32-bit union:
  - `cmd`: 8 bits
  - `state`: 4 bits
  - reserved: 20 bits
- `mb_chnl_cmd_t`:
  - `mb_chnl_hdr_t hdr`
  - `u32 param1`
  - `u32 param2`
  - `u32 param3`

See:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:109-127`
- CP-identical definition:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:108-126`

Thus the semantic message is exactly 16 bytes and consists only of four 32-bit words. There are no PSRAM-specific wire structs.

The mailbox callback types are:

```c
typedef void (*chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)(void *param, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf);
typedef void (*chnl_tx_isr_t)(void *param);
typedef void (*chnl_rx_isr_t)(void *param, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf);
```

References:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:136-156`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:135-155`

The PWC channel identifiers are established in the per-core logical-channel enums:

- AP/CPU1 → CP/CPU0: `MB_CHNL_PWC` at the third CPU1→CPU0 logical channel:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:75-99`
- CP/CPU0 → AP/CPU1:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:62-87`

## 1.2 Transport ACK versus semantic PM response

These are distinct:

1. The mailbox logical-channel layer supplies a transport-level acknowledgement.
2. PWC commands frequently generate a second PWC message with the same command number as the semantic response.

The mailbox API even defines `MB_CHNL_WRITE_SYNC`, but the PM code does not use it for these operations:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:158-166`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/mailbox_channel.h:227-244`

Both AP and CP instead call `mb_chnl_write()` asynchronously and maintain their own completion state variables.

AP initialization registers all three callbacks, although TX and TX-completion callbacks are empty:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:285-288`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:445-454`

CP does the same:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:196-200`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:280-289`

## 1.3 Message-send retry behavior

Current SMP AP sends a PWC message through `pm_cp1_mailbox_send_data()`:

- fills `hdr.cmd`, `param1`, `param2`, `param3`;
- calls `mb_chnl_write(MB_CHNL_PWC, ...)`;
- retries after 2 ms;
- gives up after more than five retries.

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:260-283`

CP uses essentially the same retry loop, with an additional mailbox sleep vote around the send:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:164-189`

The CP mailbox status can be queried with `MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS`; `PM_CHNL_STATE_BUSY == 1`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:50-51`
- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:760-765`

## 1.4 ISR-to-thread handoff

In current SMP, the CP RX ISR does not perform PSRAM initialization directly. For command `0x7`, it creates a `low_pwr_core_msg_t` and pushes it to the low-power worker queue:

- RX dispatch:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:200-225`
- Internal type:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/low_pwr_core.h:4-29`
- Queue push:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c:135-158`
- Worker receive and dispatch:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c:159-170`

This is the correct model for OpenVela as well: copy/enqueue in mailbox context, perform PM callbacks and allocator operations in a worker thread.

---

# 2. Command constants and associated enums

The exact command constants are:

```c
#define PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD              0x7
#define PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD        0x8
#define PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD    0x9
#define PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD                  0xa
#define PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD                   0xc
```

References:

- CP: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:25-40`
- AP: `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:26-41`

## PSRAM vote module enum

`pm_power_psram_module_name_e` is the command-`0x7` `param1` type. Current CP values are:

| Value | Enumerator |
|---:|---|
| 0 | `PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_FFT` |
| 1 | `...AUDP_SBC` |
| 2 | `...AUDP_AUDIO` |
| 3 | `...AUDP_I2S` |
| 4 | `...VIDP_JPEG_EN` |
| 5 | `...VIDP_H264_EN` |
| 6 | `...VIDP_JPEG_DE` |
| 7 | `...VIDP_DMA2D` |
| 8 | `...VIDP_LCD` |
| 9 | `...APP` |
| 10 | `...AS_MEM` |
| 11 | `...CPU1` |
| 12 | `...MEDIA` |
| 13 | `...LVGL_CODE_RUN` |
| 14 | `...AS_SECTIONS` |
| 15 | `...FORCE_ON` — CP header only |
| 16 | `...MAX` — CP header |

References:

- CP enum:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:129-148`
- AP enum, which ends at `AS_SECTIONS` and then `MAX`:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:134-152`

This AP/CP header asymmetry matters. OpenVela should not assume AP’s `MAX` value is a valid CP vote module, and should use an explicitly supported module value rather than serializing a local `MAX`.

## Power-state enum

Command-`0x7` `param2` and current SMP response `param1` use:

```c
typedef enum
{
    PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON = 0,
    PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF,
    PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_NONE
} pm_power_module_state_e;
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/modules/pm.h:238-243`

Therefore:

- `0` means **on**
- `1` means **off**
- `2` means **none/invalid**

This is easy to misread because “success” is also conventionally zero.

---

# 3. Command `0x7`: PSRAM power vote/control

## 3.1 AP → CP request

Current SMP AP sends:

```text
cmd    = 0x7
param1 = pm_power_psram_module_name_e module
param2 = pm_power_module_state_e power_state
param3 = 0
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:457-470`

The public API is:

```c
bk_err_t bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(
    pm_power_psram_module_name_e module,
    pm_power_module_state_e power_state);
```

Documented at:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:552-568`

## 3.2 CP handling

The CP RX ISR maps the request to:

```text
LOW_PWR_CORE_PSRAM_POWER
param1 = module
param2 = power_state
param3 = original param3
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:223-225`

The worker calls:

```c
bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl(msg.param1, msg.param2);
```

then sends:

```text
cmd    = 0x7
param1 = msg.param2       // requested ON/OFF state
param2 = 0
param3 = 0
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/low_pwr_core.c:216-220`

Notably, `ret` from `bk_pm_module_vote_psram_ctrl()` is computed but **not returned**. Thus current SMP command `0x7` response conveys the resulting/requested state, not an error code.

## 3.3 CP vote bitmap and physical transition

CP maintains:

```c
static uint32_t s_pm_psram_ctrl_state;
```

Each module corresponds to a bit. On an ON vote:

- raise VDDDIG if this is the first vote;
- call `bk_psram_init()`;
- retry initialization up to three calls total;
- optionally watchdog-reboot after the third failure;
- set the module bit.

On OFF:

- clear the module bit;
- only physically deinitialize when the bitmap becomes zero and PSRAM is not force-on;
- lower VDDDIG;
- set the shared power-down magic;
- notify/query AP using command `0x8` with `param1 == 1`.

References:

- bitmap and implementation:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:627-687`
- public wrapper:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:704-719`
- magic value and shared fields:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:46-94`

The CP sets the vote bit even if initialization failed and watchdog support is disabled, because bit-setting occurs after the retry block regardless of final `ret`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:643-665`

That is another reason OpenVela should not infer “hardware definitely initialized” solely from receiving state `ON`.

## 3.4 AP response handling and callbacks

AP command-`0x7` RX handling:

- `param1 == 0` (`PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON`):
  - queue `PM_AP_CORE_PSRAM_STATE_NOTIFY`
  - set message state to `PM_AP_PSRAM_POWER_ON`
- `param1 == 1`:
  - no callback is queued in this branch
- any other value:
  - local `ret = BK_FAIL`
- in all cases, set the command-`0x7` completion state to `FINISH`.

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:346-363`

The synchronous AP caller:

- clears `s_pm_psram_power_ctrl` to `INIT`;
- sends command `0x7`;
- busy-waits against the AP AON counter for nominally 100 ms;
- logs timeout;
- nevertheless returns `BK_OK`;
- for ON, invokes the PSRAM callback directly after the wait.

Command `0x8` is bidirectional and overloaded.

## 4.1 CP → AP allocator usage query

Current SMP CP calls:

```c

```

Reference:

- declaration:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/include/driver/pwr_clk.h:399-413`
- implementation:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:521-556`

For `using_psram_type == 0`, it sends:

```text
cmd    = 0x8
param1 = 0
param2 = 0
param3 = 0
```

Then it:

- clears `s_pm_cp1_psram_malloc_state`;
- clears cached count;
- waits up to 100 ms using CP AON RTC;
- returns `s_pm_cp1_psram_malloc_count`;
- returns zero immediately if AP/CPU1 is not boot-ready.

When AP receives command `0x8`, `param1 == 0`, it queues:

```text

param1 = PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD  // numeric 8
param2 = incoming param2
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:364-382`

The AP worker obtains:

```c

```

and sends the semantic response:

```text
cmd    = 0x8
param1 = 0x8             // response discriminator, not a status
param2 = used_count
param3 = 0
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pm_ap_core.c:114-118`

```c

When the CP vote bitmap reaches zero, it does:

```c

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pwr_clk.c:674-681`

param1 = 1   // PM_AP_PSRAM_POWER_OFF
param2 = 0
param3 = 0

# 8. PSRAM callbacks and AP-local callback data types

PSRAM callback types are AP-local; they are not sent over the mailbox.

```c
typedef enum
{
    PM_AP_PSRAM_POWER_ON = 0,
    PM_AP_PSRAM_POWER_OFF,
    PM_AP_PSRAM_POWER_MAX
} pm_ap_psram_power_state_e;

typedef bk_err_t (*psram_power_state_callback_fn)(
    uint32_t param1, uint32_t param2);

typedef struct
{
    pm_power_psram_module_name_e dev_id;
    psram_power_state_callback_fn psram_on_cb_fn;
    psram_power_state_callback_fn psram_off_cb_fn;
    uint32_t param1;
    uint32_t param2;
} pm_ap_psram_power_state_callback_info_t;
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/driver/pm_ap_core.h:46-72`

Registration stores callbacks indexed by `dev_id` and initializes callback-state bitmaps:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pm_ap_misc.c:280-298`

Dispatch behavior:

- ON callback is executed only for bits in `s_pm_handle_psram_callback_state`, then its bit is cleared.
- OFF invokes all registered OFF callbacks and re-arms all corresponding ON bits.
- Stored `param1` and `param2` are currently ignored during dispatch; callbacks are invoked as `callback(0, 0)`.

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/driver/pwr_clk/pm_ap_misc.c:326-353`

This means OpenVela does not need to emulate the callback registry to be wire-compatible. It only needs an internal mechanism to wake any PSRAM users and quiesce them on notification.

# 10. Device IDs and initialization behavior

The recognized IDs are:

```c
PSRAM_APS6408L_ID       = 0x8d09  // 8 MiB
PSRAM_APS128XXO_OB9_ID  = 0x8d08  // 16 MiB
PSRAM_W955D8MKY_5J_ID   = 0x1c8f or 0x1f8f by configuration // treated as 4 MiB
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/include/psram_hal.h:39-46`

The current CP initialization sequence is:

1. Return immediately if already initialized.
2. Reject interrupt-context initialization.
3. Lazily create and lock a PSRAM mutex.
4. Select 1.95 V.
5. Enable PSRAM power and clock.
6. Use cached flash ID if valid, otherwise probe.
7. Call `psram_hal_config_init()`.
8. Fail only if returned `actual_id == 0`.
9. Set default clock.
10. Warn on capacity mismatch.
11. update cached ID;
12. set `s_psram_init_done = true`.

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:249-369`

PSRAM is also explicitly initialized at CP driver startup in this tree:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c:553-563`

Therefore AP startup may find the PHY already active before sending its first command-`0x7` vote. A vote is still needed to prevent later CP vote-based shutdown.

# 11. Capacity mismatch behavior and hazards

Current SMP defines:

```c
PSRAM_4M_SIZE  = 0x00400000
PSRAM_8M_SIZE  = 0x00800000
PSRAM_16M_SIZE = 0x01000000
```

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:32-34`

After successful hardware initialization, the driver compares detected ID against `CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY`:

- W955 → expect 4 MiB;
- APS6408L → expect 8 MiB;
- APS128 → expect 16 MiB;
- unknown → warning.

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:328-344`

## Exact mismatch result

A mismatch:

- only logs `MEM_STATIC_LOGW`;
- does not return an error;
- does not change `CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY`;
- does not clamp heap or MPU regions;
- does not alter detected ID;
- continues to set `s_psram_init_done = true`;
- returns `BK_OK`.

References:

- warning:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:328-344`
- successful completion:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/driver/psram/psram_driver.c:346-369`

Thus a 4/8 MiB physical device with a 16 MiB link/layout remains a successful initialization from the driver’s perspective. High addresses can alias or corrupt lower physical PSRAM.

## Probe caveats

The HAL probe order is:

1. 8 MiB APS6408L;
2. 16 MiB APS128;
3. W955.

Reference:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/psram_hal.c:362-413`

There are two weak behaviors:

1. When a nonzero cached ID is supplied, `psram_hal_config_init()` ignores the specific initializer’s failure return and returns the cached `type` anyway:
   `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/psram_hal.c:375-391`
2. The final W955 branch returns `type` without testing its `ret`:
   `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/cp/middleware/soc/common/hal/psram_hal.c:409-413`

So `actual_id != 0` is not a strong guarantee that the selected ID was positively verified in every path.

The mailbox transport itself already:

- represents the message as four `uint32_t` words:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:43-49`
- validates CP-originated 16-byte envelopes:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:316-325`
- sends the transport ACK before passing PWC to the semantic callback:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:440-465`
- exposes PWC send and callback registration:
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:470-473`
  and
  `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:516-520`

That transport layer is already sufficient; the smallest changes belong in the PWC worker, not in the mailbox framing.

---

# 13. Smallest protocol-compatible OpenVela design

The minimal implementation should preserve the exact four-word protocol and add no CP-defined fields.

## 13.1 Define only the existing command and enum values

Locally define:

```c
#define PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD           0x7u
#define PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD     0x8u
#define PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD 0x9u
#define PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD               0xau
#define PM_GET_PM_DATA_CMD                0xcu

#define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON          0u
#define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF         1u

#define PM_AP_PSRAM_POWER_OFF             1u
```

Use explicit `uint32_t` fields on wire. Do not depend on C enum size across OpenVela/Armino builds.

## 13.2 Keep PSRAM physically on while OpenVela maps or executes from it

The current OpenVela layout reserves AP PSRAM sections at `0x60a00000..0x61000000`:

- `/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/hardware/bk7258_psram.h:22-27`

If any live AP code, data, heap, or slab relies on this mapping, OpenVela should send one command-`0x7` ON vote at PWC startup and retain it for the entire AP lifetime:

```text
cmd    = 0x7
param1 = a real supported module, preferably AS_SECTIONS (14)
param2 = ON (0)
param3 = 0
```

Do not send OFF while OpenVela still has mapped/live PSRAM users.

Do not serialize AP’s `PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_NAME_MAX`; AP and CP disagree about where `MAX` falls. Use the explicit supported numeric module.

If the CP configuration accepts and intentionally uses `FORCE_ON` value 15, that is CP-defined, but AP’s current public enum does not contain it. The least surprising protocol-compatible choice is therefore the AP-defined `AS_SECTIONS` vote, value 14.

## 13.3 Handle incoming `0x7` as a state response only

Record:

- `param1 == 0`: CP reports ON;
- `param1 == 1`: CP reports OFF;
- otherwise protocol/error state.

Wake a waiter if OpenVela’s startup sends an ON vote. Do not interpret `param2` as ID or capacity; current CP sends it as zero.

Because CP’s current implementation does not return the initialization `ret`, receiving ON is not an absolute hardware-probe guarantee. Treat it as vote/protocol completion, then rely on a controlled memory smoke test only if the product requires one.

## 13.4 Implement command `0x8` exactly

For incoming:

```text
cmd=0x8, param1=0
```

obtain the real amount used by the OpenVela PSRAM allocator, if one exists, and reply:

```text
cmd    = 0x8
param1 = 0x8
param2 = actual_used_count
param3 = 0
```

If OpenVela has no dynamic allocator in PSRAM and only fixed statically reserved regions, returning zero for **allocator usage** is compatible, provided it means “no dynamic PSRAM allocations.” It must not be presented as “PSRAM unused” if fixed code/data/slabs remain live.

For incoming:

```text
cmd=0x8, param1=1
```

mark PSRAM unavailable and invoke local off/quiesce notification. Send no semantic command-`0x8` response.

Ideally this notification should never occur while the retained `AS_SECTIONS` ON vote exists. If it does occur, treat it as a fatal lifecycle inconsistency rather than probing or accessing PSRAM.

## 13.5 Implement `0x9` as diagnostics only

Dump actual allocator/fixed-region accounting if available. Otherwise no-op after transport ACK. Send no response.

## 13.6 Implement only necessary `0xa` recovery behavior

On incoming command `0xa`:

1. quiesce OpenVela services;
2. stop users of shared PSRAM/mailbox resources;
3. only send module `INIT`/`FINISH` responses for module IDs OpenVela genuinely implements.

Wire form:

```text
cmd    = 0xa
param1 = supported recovery module ID
param2 = 0 or 1
param3 = 0
```

Do not invent a “PSRAM complete,” “capacity,” or “device ID” recovery module. The supplied vendor tree does not define one.

If the platform does not yet support AP shutdown, retaining the AP/PSRAM vote and explicitly declining to claim recovery completion is safer than sending fabricated completion states.

## 13.7 Do not extend `0xc`

If OpenVela needs the existing PM queries, support only selector values `0`, `1`, and `2`, with response data taken from `param2`.

Do **not** define unofficial selectors for:

- initialized state;
- PSRAM ID;
- capacity.

The CP has no matching implementation. Such requests would fall through to the CP default selector path and return zero, which is ambiguous and unsafe.

## 13.8 Capacity policy

Because CP does not report capacity over PWC, the smallest safe product implementation is:

1. keep the validated 16 MiB OpenVela static layout only for boards whose fitted PSRAM part is known to be 16 MiB;
2. retain the compile-time 16 MiB consistency check;
3. fail board qualification/build configuration if hardware BOM and CP `CONFIG_PSRAM_CAPACITY` disagree;
4. do not treat CP command-`0x7` ON as proof of 16 MiB;
5. do not add capacity to an existing response field.

If runtime capacity discovery is mandatory, it requires either:

- an explicit versioned CP protocol extension implemented on both sides; or
- an early destructive alias probe before any AP/CP PSRAM allocation or code placement.

The former is cleaner but is outside the existing protocol. The latter is not a minimal PWC implementation and is unsafe once shared PSRAM is live.

---

# Final recommendation

The smallest faithful OpenVela implementation is:

- leave the existing 16-byte mailbox transport unchanged;
- add a tiny PWC semantic state machine in `bk7258_pm_pwc.c`;
- send and retain one command-`0x7` `AS_SECTIONS` ON vote;
- wait for the current-SMP state-valued `0x7` response;
- answer only command-`0x8,param1=0` with `{0x8, 0x8, real_dynamic_used_count, 0}`;
- treat `0x8,param1=1` as an off notification;
- make `0x9` diagnostic-only;
- use `0xa` solely for genuine shutdown callbacks;
- keep `0xc` limited to its three existing PM selectors;
- expose no fabricated CP PSRAM initialized/ID/capacity values.

That is protocol-compatible with the supplied `bk_avdk_smp` CP and avoids mistakenly importing older `bk_idk` response semantics or local-only PSRAM getter APIs into the wire protocol.

output:
<task id="ses_048a9500fffe3fVQYq0TgoBBN1" state="completed">
<task_result>
**Scope**

No files were modified. I inspected the allocator, mapping and type headers, generated PSRAM partitions, callers, power lifecycle, both BK7236N/BK7239 `bk_idk` documentation copies, and the NuttX private-heap implementation.

No `psram_mem_slab.c`, `psram_mem_slab.h`, `frame_buffer_mapping.h`, or matching allocator symbols exist under either `/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk` or `/home/mi/vela_competition/vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/bk_idk`. The duplicated `bk_idk` material is documentation, not duplicated allocator source. Both documents describe the same four pools and API at [BK7236N index.rst](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/docs/bk7236n/en/developer-guide/memory_perf/index.rst:97) and [BK7239 index.rst](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/docs/bk7239/en/developer-guide/memory_perf/index.rst:97). Their claim that `psram_heap_type_t` is in `bk_idk/include/driver/psram_types.h` is stale: that header contains only PSRAM hardware types, ending at [psram_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/include/driver/psram_types.h:31). The actual enum is in [media_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/components/media_types.h:288).

**Four Pool Mapping**

The enum order and indices are fixed: `USER=0`, `AUDIO=1`, `ENCODE=2`, `YUV/DISPLAY=3`, `MAX=4` ([media_types.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/include/components/media_types.h:292)).

The generated 8 MiB build map is:

| Pool | Start | Size | End |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| USER | `0x60000000` | `0x19000` = 102,400 | `0x60019000` |
| AUDIO | `0x60019000` | `0x19000` = 102,400 | `0x60032000` |
| ENCODE | `0x60032000` | `0x15e000` = 1,433,600 | `0x60190000` |
| DISPLAY/YUV | `0x60190000` | `0x570000` = 5,701,632 | `0x60700000` |

These definitions are at [ram_regions.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/build/bk7258/app/partitions/ram_regions.h:16). They are exactly contiguous and consume the first `0x700000` bytes of PSRAM; CP/AP heaps begin afterward at lines 24-27. The 16 MiB app-ab map preserves exactly the same four boundaries ([app-ab ram_regions.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/partitions/ram_regions.h:16)).

The linker declares four separate regions using all four `*_ADDR` and `*_SIZE` constants ([bk7258_ap_bsp.ld](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/middleware/soc/bk7258_ap/bk7258_ap_bsp.ld:74)). The C mapping does not use those addresses: it casts fixed `0x60000000` to four adjacent byte arrays ([frame_buffer_mapping.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/frame_buffer_mapping.h:24), [frame_buffer_mapping.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/frame_buffer_mapping.h:30)). It is correct only while:

- USER begins at `0x60000000`.
- Every next address equals the sum of all preceding sizes.
- Every preceding size preserves the alignment required by the allocator.
- There are no intentional gaps.

A native replacement should use each explicit `CONFIG_PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_*_ADDR`, not reproduce this implicit struct arithmetic.

**Legacy Metadata Layout**

The allocator assumes 32-bit pointers and 4-byte words. It repeatedly casts pointers through `uint32_t`, for example during initial sizing, splitting, and merging ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:45), [psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:196), [psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:285)).

On that ABI:

```text
Allocated block:
  +0x00 uint32_t corrupt_check = 0x8338
  +0x04 uint32_t size          = total block bytes, including this header
  +0x08 user payload
  header = 8 bytes

Free block:
  +0x00 uint32_t corrupt_check = 0xa55a
  +0x04 uint32_t free_size     = total free extent, including descriptor
  +0x08 fb_block_free *next
  +0x0c fb_block_free *previous
  descriptor = 16 bytes
```

The declarations are at [psram_mem_slab.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/include/psram_mem_slab.h:13), with marker values at [psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:25). Free and used layouts deliberately share the first two 32-bit fields so a used header can become a free descriptor in place.

Initialization places one free descriptor at the exact configured start and computes its extent as `align_down(start + configured_size, 4) - start` ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:38)). Despite the comment, the start itself is not aligned upward. Consequently, all starts must already be suitably aligned and each enabled pool must be at least 16 bytes. Up to three bytes at the physical end are discarded.

A request is rounded up to four bytes, then charged an 8-byte used header; total block size is raised to at least 16 bytes so it can later hold a free descriptor ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:116)). Thus:

```text
legacy_total = max(align_up(request, 4) + 8, 16)
returned alignment = 4 bytes
malloc(0) consumes 16 bytes and returns an 8-byte payload area
```

**Best Fit, Splitting, and Coalescing**

The free list is kept in ascending physical-address order. Allocation scans the entire list and retains the smallest eligible block, so it is true best fit; equal-size ties retain the first, lowest-address block ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:141)).

Allocation is taken from the high-address end of a free extent. Normally the free node remains at the same address and its size is reduced; the used header is written at `free_start + remaining_size` ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:199)). If the remainder would be smaller than 16 bytes, the complete free block is consumed ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:164)).

There is a deliberate root-sentinel exception. The first free node has `previous == NULL` and is eligible only when at least 16 bytes will remain. Exact or near-exact consumption is permitted only for non-root nodes, and exact removal asserts that `previous != NULL` ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:147), [psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:185)). Therefore every pool permanently retains at least its 16-byte root free descriptor. A completely empty initialized pool reports one free extent, not zero free nodes.

Freeing searches all four configured ranges to infer the pool ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:259)). It then walks the address-ordered list:

- If the released extent immediately follows a free node, it merges downward into that node and then also merges the next free node if adjacent ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:281)).
- If it precedes the current free node, it inserts after `prev_node` and merges with the current node when adjacent ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:307)).
- Otherwise it appends after the last free node ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:344)).

Coalescing is eager and can combine both neighbors in one free operation. The permanent root makes insertion before the first node “impossible”; that path asserts rather than supporting it.

**API, Statistics, Locking, and Lifecycle**

`bk_psram_frame_buffer_init()` returns no status, clears only the four control arrays, and reconstructs each enabled pool in place ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:77)). Calling it with live allocations silently invalidates them.

`malloc(type, size)` returns `NULL` only for exhaustion. An uninitialized pool logs and asserts rather than returning an error ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:104)). `free(NULL)` is a no-op ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:224)); non-null free has no type argument and discovers the pool by address.

There are no maintained allocation counters, current usage, high-water mark, requested-byte accounting, or formal statistics API. `dump_blocks()` reconstructs free/used information by walking the free list and linearly scanning in-band headers ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:363)). Reported used sizes include the 8-byte header and any absorbed tail; free sizes include free descriptors. Its `FB_FREE_PATTERN` “not merged yet” case at lines 483-488 is not a stable post-`free()` state.

Allocation and list mutation disable global interrupts ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:131), [psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:255)). This gives task/ISR exclusion only if that macro globally serializes every participating CPU. In an SMP build, local interrupt masking is not a cross-CPU lock. Free also reads and modifies the allocated header before taking the lock at lines 239-256. Initialization is wholly unlocked. Dump holds interrupts disabled while traversing and logging the entire heap, producing potentially extreme interrupt latency.

The sole initialization call is the PSRAM-on callback ([media_service.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_service/src/media_service.c:73), [media_service.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_service/src/media_service.c:115)). The PSRAM-off callback is a no-op. The `bk_idk` docs explicitly say CPU1 startup initializes it and CPU1 shutdown needs no de-registration ([BK7236N index.rst](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_idk/docs/bk7236n/en/developer-guide/memory_perf/index.rst:160)). This assumes all allocations and users disappear before PSRAM power-down and that no stale pointer is used after the next reinitialization.

Only ENCODE and DISPLAY are used by visible callers. They request an extra 32 bytes and manually align frame payloads to 32 bytes ([frame_buffer.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/multimedia/comm/frame_buffer.c:39), [frame_buffer.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/multimedia/comm/frame_buffer.c:41), [frame_buffer.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/multimedia/comm/frame_buffer.c:87)). The allocator itself promises only 4-byte alignment.

**Known Bugs and Unsafe Assumptions**

1. `heap_size[type]` is indexed before validating or reducing `type` modulo four, causing out-of-bounds access for invalid enums ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:110)). Later modulo conversion would also wrongly alias invalid types onto valid pools.
2. Request alignment and `size + sizeof(header)` have no overflow checks. Large requests can wrap and receive a dangerously undersized allocation ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:118)).
3. All pointer arithmetic truncates through `uint32_t`; it is non-portable to 64-bit address spaces.
4. The allocated marker check is commented out. Free blindly overwrites metadata before validating the pointer, pool, allocation state, or lock ownership ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:239)).
5. Double-free can overwrite an active free-list node’s `0xa55a` marker with `0xf00f` before eventually asserting or corrupting the list.
6. Interior, stale, one-past, and arbitrary pointers can be interpreted as headers. Range membership alone does not establish that a pointer was returned by this allocator.
7. Membership accepts `mem_ptr == heap_start + configured_size`, an invalid one-past endpoint ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:61)).
8. The mapping ignores explicit addresses and assumes contiguous regions beginning at hard-coded `0x60000000`.
9. Pool starts and sizes are not validated for alignment, minimum size, overlap, arithmetic overflow, PSRAM capacity, or conflicts with subsequent heaps.
10. Local interrupt masking is insufficient SMP protection unless the platform macro implements a real global mechanism. Long best-fit scans and debug logging also make interrupt-disabled latency unbounded by a small constant.
11. Reinitialization and power transitions are not synchronized with allocation/free operations or outstanding owners.
12. The diagnostic scanner trusts corrupt sizes and may skip outside the heap; its 1000-block safeguard applies only to unknown-marker steps, not valid-looking corrupt sizes ([psram_mem_slab.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/media_utils/src/psram_mem_slab.c:440)).

**NuttX-Native Guidance**

Use four independent `struct mm_heap_s *` instances, one per enum value. Do not use one heap with four `mm_addregion()` calls: that would combine statistics and allocation policy and would no longer enforce functional pool boundaries.

Initialize each instance with `mm_initialize(name, explicit_start, explicit_size)` ([NuttX mm.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/mm/mm.h:274)). With default configuration, NuttX stores `struct mm_heap_s` inside that pool, aligns the remaining region, installs head/tail guards, and creates one free chunk ([mm_initialize.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_initialize.c:248), [mm_initialize.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_initialize.c:153)). Expect usable capacities and returned addresses to differ from the legacy allocator.

Keep the compatibility API, but validate `type < PSRAM_HEAP_MAX` before indexing. Dispatch allocation directly to `mm_malloc(heaps[type], size)`. For untyped free, find exactly one pool using strict half-open boundaries `[start, end)`, verify `mm_heapmember()`, and call `mm_free()` on that heap. NuttX’s membership check itself uses strict guard-node boundaries ([mm_heapmember.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_heapmember.c:58)). Exact-pointer validity remains an API precondition; range membership cannot make arbitrary interior pointers safe.

Select NuttX’s default heap manager if preserving best-fit behavior matters. It searches a size-ordered free list for the smallest satisfactory chunk ([mm_malloc.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_malloc.c:225)), splits only when at least `MM_MIN_CHUNK` remains ([mm_malloc.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_malloc.c:278)), and coalesces both physical neighbors on free ([mm_free.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_free.c:193)). TLSF would preserve isolation and general semantics but not the exact best-fit policy.

NuttX normally provides `MM_ALIGN = 2 * sizeof(uintptr_t)` unless configured otherwise ([NuttX mm.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/mm/mm.h:165)); its default allocator explicitly guarantees 8-byte data alignment ([mm_malloc.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_malloc.c:166)). Preserve the existing frame-level 32-byte alignment wrapper or replace it with `mm_memalign(heap, 32, size)` after checking whether callers require the separately allocated `frame_buffer_t` prefix.

Use `mm_mallinfo()` per pool for arena, free/allocated chunks, current occupied bytes, largest free chunk, and peak usage ([mm_mallinfo.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_mallinfo.c:129), [malloc.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/include/malloc.h:64)). `mm_heapfree()` and `mm_heapfree_largest()` provide direct free metrics ([mm_mallinfo.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_mallinfo.c:187)). These figures include NuttX allocator overhead, so expose both configured region size and allocator statistics.

Each NuttX heap owns a recursive mutex ([internal mm.h](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm.h:246)); allocation/free lock around metadata changes ([mm_malloc.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_malloc.c:220), [mm_free.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_free.c:160)). This is SMP-safe task-context synchronization, but ordinary `mm_malloc/mm_free` should not be treated as ISR APIs. ISR users should use a preallocated fixed-block pool or defer work to task context.

Finally, keep lifecycle state and its transition lock in internal SRAM, not PSRAM. On orderly shutdown: mark all four pools unavailable, block new calls, quiesce users, verify no live allocations, call `mm_uninitialize()` while PSRAM is still powered, null all handles, then power down. NuttX deinitialization releases delayed frees, KASAN/procfs registration, and the heap mutex but does not prove that callers released every allocation ([mm_initialize.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/openvela/nuttx/mm/mm_heap/mm_initialize.c:393)). After unplanned PSRAM loss, treat every old pointer as invalid and construct four fresh heaps only after power and mapping are restored.

38: static void frame_buffer_heap_init(uint8_t type, uint8_t* heap, uint32_t heap_size)
39: {
40: 	// align first free descriptor to word boundary
41: 	frame_mem_heap.heap[type] = (struct fb_block_free *)heap;
42: 
43: 	// initialize the first block
44: 	// compute the size from the last aligned word before heap_end
45: 	frame_mem_heap.heap[type]->free_size = ((uint32_t)&heap[heap_size] & (~3)) - (uint32_t)(frame_mem_heap.heap[type]);
46: 	frame_mem_heap.heap[type]->corrupt_check = FB_LIST_PATTERN;
47: 	frame_mem_heap.heap[type]->next = NULL;
48: 	frame_mem_heap.heap[type]->previous = NULL;
49: 	frame_mem_heap.heap_size[type] = heap_size;
50: 	// LOGD("%s heap:%p, type %d size %d\n", __func__, heap, type, heap_size);
51: 	// LOGD("%s, free_size:%d, check:0x%x\r\n", __func__, frame_mem_heap.heap[type]->free_size, frame_mem_heap.heap[type]->corrupt_check);
